title: Zesty Crisp Croatian Cashew Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Croatian dish featuring cashews and lardons, served in agave leaves, with a sour and crisp texture, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the agave leaves and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cashews to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread 2-3 cashews onto each agave leaf, leaving a small space between each cashew.
Top each cashew with a few pieces of crispy lardons.
Place the agave leaves on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the cashews are lightly toasted.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Zesty Crisp Croatian Cashew Skewers warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
